use_cases: User registration forms requiring secure password creation with real-time validation
Login forms with password visibility toggle for improved UX
Account security settings for password updates and resets
Developer authentication interfaces for SaaS applications
Onboarding flows with password strength guidance
ai_summary: A password input component with real-time strength validation featuring a visual strength meter, animated progress bars, and a requirements checklist. The component includes a password visibility toggle with eye icons and provides immediate visual feedback as users type. Built with Tailwind CSS for a clean, minimalist aesthetic suitable for authentication forms across SaaS, fintech, and e-commerce platforms.
